youtube.description:
Row, row, row your boat with Robo! Robo rows down the river and meets four friends on the riverbank: Frog, Duck, Turtle and Fish. Listen for who is hiding, peek, count 3-2-1 for the reveal, then row your arms slow with Frog and Turtle and fast with Duck and Fish. Say ribbit, quack and blub blub, fill the riverbank friends tracker, and play the fast-or-slow game.

Your child learns: fast and slow (the boat, the oars, the water and the voice all change speed); river animals and their sounds (frog, duck, turtle, fish); listening and guessing; moving along with a song.

Sing at home: sit on the floor facing your toddler, hold hands and rock back and forth to row the boat. Row slowly for the slow verses and quickly for the fast ones, and make each animal's sound together. The first verse, "Row, Row, Row Your Boat", is a traditional public domain nursery rhyme sung to its traditional tune; the river verses with Frog, Duck, Turtle and Fish are original, written for Toy Box Friends.

Made for kids. Toy Box Friends: 3D learning videos for babies, toddlers and preschool.

do.text: Row with me! Row, row, row!
Four friends live on the river! Let's find them!
Ooh! Someone splashes at the end!
Row your arms with me! Pull... and pull!

do.text: Who's on the riverbank? Shh! Listen!
Your turn! Say ribbit like Frog!
Who's on the riverbank? Shh! Listen!
Your turn! Flap your wings and quack!
Who's on the riverbank? Shh! Listen!
Hello! I'm Turtle! Slow and steady!
Head out, head in, head out, head in,
Your turn! Be a slow turtle! Hide your head...
Who's on the riverbank? Shh! Listen!
Your turn! Swish your hands like a fish!
Is the boat fast or slow?
Who is slow and steady? Point to it!
Bye-bye, river friends! Row, row, bye-bye!
